options.name: cidr
options.description: The cidr value of address blocks to be created.

options.name: count
options.description: Number of address blocks to generate. Default 1 if not set. Maximum 20.

options.name: id
options.description: An application specific resource identity of a resource

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: tag_filters
options.description: Filter dict to filter address blocks by tags
